description: An Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability exists in the order processing workflow of Magento 2.1 prior to 2.1.18, Magento 2.2 prior to 2.2.9, Magento 2.3 prior to 2.3.2. This can lead to unauthorized access to order details.
